Sure, here are two hints for the given step:

Hint 1: Consider what it means for a matrix to be full column rank. A matrix is full column rank if its columns are linearly independent. In the context of one-hot encoding, think about whether the columns $$sex_{male}$$ and $$sex_{female}$$ can be linearly dependent.

Hint 2: Recall that in one-hot encoding, each row will have exactly one '1' and the rest '0's for the encoded categories. For the sex column, if a passenger is male, $$sex_{male}$$ will be $$1$$ and $$sex_{female}$$ will be $$0$$, and vice versa for female. Consider how this affects the linear independence of the columns.
